items.markdown:
![Explore BBQ Ideas for Your Next Australian Outdoor Feast | TikTok](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07140925-1150-0139-0000-c839382c944b:4)
BBQ Pods offer a premium, plug-and-play outdoor kitchen experience. Local suppliers like **Future Shade** supply models ranging from a 2.2m Mini Pod to a 3.5m Entertainer. They come fully loaded with a built-in BBQ, fridge, sink, and smart integrations, and can be viewed at the **Home Innovations Frankston** display centre.[](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DU79UF1Eo1E/) [[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DU79UF1Eo1E/)[[2]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DVYXhIfEopg/)[[3]](https://www.instagram.com/bbqpodsmelb/)[[4]](https://www.facebook.com/100063642996716/videos/bbqpods-have-arrived-in-melbourne-sydney-perth-melbourne-display-centre-open-hom/1333258748549859/)

**Pricing & Models:** 

- **Mini BBQ Pod:** Roughly $16,999 - $20,000, measuring 2.2m and ideal for smaller spaces.
- **Entertainer & Social Pods:** Ranging between $19,250 and $23,950, featuring larger layouts, integrated TVs, and extended bench space.[](https://expressportables.com.au/collections/bbq-pods) [[1]](https://expressportables.com.au/collections/bbq-pods)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:1709509888967921798&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://outdoorlivinghq.com.au/product/diablo-outdoor-kitchen-pod/)[[4]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DVYXhIfEopg/)[[5]](https://www.outdoorsdomain.com.au/products/artusi-80cm-316-grade-stainless-steel-built-in-bbq-with-hood)

**Key Features & Delivery:** 

- **Weatherproof:** Designed for Australian conditions with 304 marine-grade stainless steel and electric doors that close off to protect the kitchen when not in use.
- **Installation:** Delivered fully assembled as a plug-and-play unit. You just need to arrange local plumbing and power connections.[](https://www.instagram.com/bbqpodsmelb/) [[1]](https://www.instagram.com/bbqpodsmelb/)[[2]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DVYXhIfEopg/)[[3]](https://www.futureshade.com.au/bbq-pods)

For custom builds, full catalogues, and delivery times, view the [Future Shade BBQ Pods](https://www.futureshade.com.au/bbq-pods) page or book a viewing at the Frankston showroom via the [BBQPods Melbourne Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/bbqpodsmelb/).[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DU79UF1Eo1E/)
